summary: The portfolio spans fewer than ten repositories, dozens of owners and tens of thousands of lines. [O1] holds 54% of lines; blank lines alone account for 21% and are attributed to [O1].

Cross-repository ownership varies materially: code written elsewhere accounts for 80% in [R1], 78% in [R2] and 66% in [R3]. Ownership by noncontributors ranges from 0% in [R2] to 57% in [R3], and ownership methods agree in no repositories.

At [T0], inactive owners account for 76% and the principal owner holds 54%. Inactivity eased from 78% at [T-3], while principal-owner share rose from 51%; the next blank-line milestone is projected at [T+22]. Code half-life is 2 years.

okr.objective: Improve ownership resilience and consistency across the portfolio.

keyResults.text: Reduce principal-owner concentration from the [T0] baseline of 54.3%, reversing the increase from 51.2% at [T-3].
Lower inactive-owner share from the [T0] baseline of 76.3%; it has eased from 77.9% at [T-3].
Increase agreement between ownership methods from a baseline of no repositories in agreement.
